title: Delivery Hero co-founder and CEO Niklas Östberg reverses his decision to step down in 2027, as the company prepares for Uber's €13B takeover and an asset sale (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Delivery Hero co-founder and CEO Niklas Östberg reverses his decision to step down in 2027, as the company prepares for Uber's €13B takeover and an asset sale — ‘Teflon’ Niklas Östberg to guide German food delivery group through asset sales and a new future under its US rival
contentText:
Financial Times :

Delivery Hero co-founder and CEO Niklas Östberg reverses his decision to step down in 2027, as the company prepares for Uber's €13B takeover and an asset sale   —  ‘Teflon’ Niklas Östberg to guide German food delivery group through asset sales and a new future under its US rival
